html:
Custom website design $2950

Yes, you can get a fully owned custom website for $2,950. Choose the Launch package, pay a 50 % deposit, and receive a live site in about a week.

How it works for a new business website

  1. Request the Free homepage remake – no call, no payment details.
  2. Approve the design or keep it and move to the Launch package.
  3. Pay 50 % deposit, provide your content, and let us build up to 5 pages with custom design, contact forms, and basic SEO.
  4. Review the draft, give final approval, and pay the remaining balance.
  5. Your site goes live on Cloudflare Pages (hosting $0/month) and you own the code, content, and domain.

What you get and the costs

  • Launch package: $2,950 total, includes up to 5 pages, custom design, about a week of work, contact forms, and SEO basics.
  • Deposit: 50 % up front, balance due at launch.
  • Hosting: $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • Post‑launch care: 90 days free, then optional care plans at $295/month or $595/month, cancel anytime.

FAQ

Do I own the website after launch? Yes. You receive full ownership of the code, content, and domain.

What if I need more than 5 pages? For unlimited sections, galleries, admin panels, and integrations, see the Signature service starting at $7,500.

How quickly will my site be ready? The Launch package is typically completed in about a week, as outlined in our guide: /guides/website-in-a-week.html.

Start your custom website design for $2,950
